5.issue_title: Validate lossless email ingestion in a private PostgreSQL trial

deliverables.description: D_1.1: Using the exact private manifest and existing dedicated PostgreSQL database, preserve complete received raw bytes and provider observations for the eight selected messages; retain private acquisition receipts and produce aggregate framing/selection/storage-readback evidence. No replacement database or wider mailbox reads.

D_1.2: Verify three observed provider threads, strict raw decoding and all MIME/inline/attachment inventory outcomes; preserve any genuinely required separately exposed original through admitted tools. Classify all truncation, defects, missing/unsupported parts and external linked targets truthfully.

D_1.3: Store version/run-linked MIME inventory, extracted text, reply relationships and provisional source-linked context; demonstrate unchanged real source/version counts on identical reimport and interpretation-only reprocessing, with proposals distinct from accepted corrections.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Prove negative cases and archive-only recovery
deliverables.description: D_1.4: Demonstrate byte-for-byte recovery without connector acquisition, frame/selection rejection, missing-content classification, source-conflict preservation, interrupted-run resume and test-labelled correction protection; exclude separately counted synthetic records from real sample totals.

D_1.5: Record exact public-safe operator invocation scopes, aggregate outcomes and limits in the implementation evidence document; preserve private receipts/diagnostics/exports outside repository; finish with dedicated instance stopped, all commands quiescent and independent final-cycle review requested.

cycles.exit_criteria: All D_1.1–D_1.5 obligations have factual evidence: exactly eight real messages across three observed threads; untruncated received source and reconciled embedded originals; storage/export byte equality; unchanged real source/version counts after repeat import and reprocessing; traceable provisional derivations; demonstrated negative/failure/resume/correction protection; synthetic totals separate. Public evidence is screened, required narrow Markdown gates pass, private archive retained and dedicated server/clients/pipe stopped. Final C_1 exit and Implementation phase exit require independent exact-revision GO; producer results alone are not GO. Any incomplete source blocks a full-import statement and successful cycle exit.

deliverables.description: Verify all fixed-sample and negative-case operator evidence, retain the aggregate acceptance report and truthful limitations without repeating fresh unchanged checks; request independent exact-revision QA at the phase boundary.

Run repository_review once on branch after final implementation changes and run_tests(scope=configured) as required in Validation; report actual inactive/no_active_tests neutrality, never a passing app-test claim. Required applicable checks must pass; unavailable checks remain blockers.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Document trial outcome and private retrieval boundary
deliverables.description: Document achieved versus incomplete outcomes, portable operator reproduction/retrieval contracts and scope limits; retain engine/aggregate evidence without private source locations or identifiers, and distinguish operation checks from deferred application tests.
